title: puccinellia festuciformis subsp. intermedia
intro: Puccinellia festuciformis subsp. intermedia, commonly known as intermediate saltwort or saltgrass, is a plant species belonging to the grass family (Poaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Puccinellia festuciformis subsp. intermedia include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory conditions due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that exhibit therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities.
